WITH event_averages AS (
  SELECT
    corpeventprx,
    AVG(anlycount) AS avg_anlycount,
    AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) AS avg_ownership_gap
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  GROUP BY corpeventprx
),
with_overall AS (
  SELECT
    corpeventprx,
    avg_anlycount,
    avg_ownership_gap,
    AVG(avg_ownership_gap) OVER () AS overall_avg_gap
  FROM event_averages
)
SELECT
  corpeventprx,
  avg_anlycount,
  avg_ownership_gap,
  avg_ownership_gap - overall_avg_gap AS gap_minus_overall_avg
FROM with_overall
WHERE overall_avg_gap IS NOT NULL;

assumptions.assumption: The ownership gap is insider ownership minus institutional ownership, averaged only over snapshots where both values are present; the overall average is the unweighted average of the non-missing event-group average gaps, including the NULL event-type group when its average gap is present.
